                        Artemis
                        Experience the Future
                        of Domain Monetization

                        A real-time traffic auction based upon the meta-data.

                        The Artemis platform breaks the industry’s downward trend with a completely new approach to monetization. Using advanced machine learning, Artemis analyses every piece of traffic and continuously adapts to the changing advertising landscape.

                        By interpreting detailed meta data, the system accurately values each visitor and routes the traffic to the highest paying advertiser, ensuring consistent performance and stronger returns for domain investors.

                        Learn more Apply for account
                          
                        Mastering
                        Domain Monetization

                        Tailored solutions for domain investors and registrars

                        For more than eighteen years, ParkLogic has been developing innovative solutions that drive stronger earnings for registrars and domain investors. Through the combination of advanced technology, expert support, and transparent processes, ParkLogic provides a reliable and proven platform that professional investors can depend on.

                        Parkiter
                        Join the revolution

                        A smart landing page for greater revenue.

                        By adopting an analytic driven approach to design, Parkiter is revolutionising the domain parking page. The traditional Pay-Per-Click (PPC) advertisements have been replaced by links that if clicked, trigger a real-time auction. Thousands of advertisers then compete for this highly targeted traffic and the user is then routed to the winning bidder within milliseconds.

                        This is an ideal solution for monetizing domain traffic that is one hundred percent ICANN compliant for registrars while producing outstanding results for domain investments.

                        Domain Investors Registrars
                          
                        Apogee
                        Data the Way You Want It
                        Apogee is a world-class dashboard designed to give you complete control over your data. Seamlessly connect multiple sources and visualize performance across every level, from individual domains to entire portfolios. Smart, flexible, and intuitive, Apogee transforms complex data into clarity you can act on.
                        Learn more
                        Subscribers
                        A Game Changer in Domain Revenue
                        Turn your traffic into lasting value. With Artemis, visitors are matched with subscription services that align with their interests, creating a continuous, compounding source of revenue. As your subscriber base grows, so does your long-term earning potential.
                        Learn more
                        AdLogic
                        Embracing the Future of Digital Advertising
                        AdLogic connects advertisers with high-quality, intent-driven traffic that converts. By tapping into natural type-in domain visits, the platform delivers audiences ready to take action, offering brands direct access to motivated buyers and measurable results that drive growth.
                        Learn more
                        SSL Plus
                        Leaving No Stone Unturned
                        SSL Plus is a next generation SSL solution designed to ensure every request to your domains resolves and creates a revenue opportunity. SSL Plus combines multi-subdomain and wildcard certificates at scale, while still responding to inbound browser requests in milliseconds, capturing traffic that would otherwise be lost.
                        Learn more
                        Enticing Cards  
                        MASSIVE DEMAND
                        ONE HUNDRED+ AD FEEDS
                        MASSIVE DEMAND

                        Artemis auctions every click in under 100 ms across 100+ global ad feeds.

                        With new feeds constantly being added, the competitive pool of advertisers keeps expanding, creating intense demand that drives maximum revenue for your domain traffic.

                        Learn more
                        INCREASING REVENUE
                        FOCUS ON PERFORMANCE
                        INCREASING REVENUE

                        At ParkLogic, performance is always a priority. From the CEO down, the team is committed to delivering stronger results through innovation and data driven insights.

                        We constantly explore new ways to unlock greater revenue from domain traffic, ensuring our clients stay ahead in an ever changing marketplace.

                        Learn more
                        REPEATABLE EARNINGS
                        SUBSCRIBER REVENUES
                        REPEATABLE EARNINGS

                        ParkLogic is transforming domain monetization by sharing earnings from users who subscribe to a range of services. Instead of relying on a single click, you now share in the lifetime value of each user.

                        As long as your domains remain with ParkLogic, this model creates a steady and growing revenue stream that builds over time.

                        Learn more
                        ALL THE TRAFFIC
                        SSL PLUS - MORE VIEWS
                        ALL THE TRAFFIC

                        All your domain traffic is monetized through the most advanced SSL certificate system in the industry. Without SSL coverage, secure requests to a domain are lost, and with them, valuable earning potential.

                        ParkLogic automatically adds both wildcard and subdomain SSL certificates, ensuring every secure request to your domains becomes a revenue opportunity.

                        Learn more
                        API DRIVEN REPORTING
                        FAST,
                        REALLY FAST!
                        API DRIVEN REPORTS

                        At the core of Apogee is an API gateway built on a state of the art database solution. Data is delivered almost instantly, so you are never left waiting for results.

                        Apogee processes everything in parallel, allowing charts and reports to load in a flash so you can stay focused on what matters most—growing your business.

                        Learn more
                        DATA YOUR WAY
                        THE APOGEE DASHBOARD
                        DATA YOUR WAY

                        The Apogee interface gives you the power to view and organize data exactly how you need it. Pull in data from any source, display it as a chart or table, and move or resize each element on your personalized dashboard.

                        For the first time, domain investors can centralize all their performance data in one place, saving time, reducing costs, and eliminating the need to log in to multiple systems.

                        Learn more
                        INTELLIGENT PRICING
                        SPOT VS. AVERAGE PRICE
                        INTELLIGENT PRICING

                        Artemis tracks over three hundred data points per domain each day to price traffic by region, device, and time with exceptional accuracy.

                        When a bidding network offers ten cents, Artemis instantly knows if Google will pay more, capturing maximum value in real time.

                        Learn more
                        GREATER EARNINGS
                        ADLOGIC ADVERTISERS
                        GREATER EARNINGS

                        Advertisers view curated domain traffic as one of the most valuable sources of online customers because it converts directly to sales. With AdLogic, they can access this premium traffic from ParkLogic’s global network.

                        Domain investors gain the full value of their traffic, receiving higher returns without the losses caused by intermediaries.

                        Learn more
                        ANALYTIC DRIVEN DESIGN
                        PARKITER RESULTS
                        ANALYTIC DRIVEN DESIGN

                        Parkiter is transforming the traditional parking model through an analytics driven approach to design. Every element is built to optimise engagement and revenue potential.

                        Instead of static pay per click ads, each link now triggers real time bidding from thousands of advertisers the instant a user clicks, turning every visit into a high value opportunity. Learn more

                        THE EXPERTSAN EXTENSION OF
                        YOUR TEAM

                        Founder Michael Gilmour has been a leading figure in the domain industry for more than two decades and is widely recognised as one of its foremost experts. After founding ParkLogic in 2007 with his now retired business partner, David Gibbs, he assembled a team of exceptional individuals who share his passion for analytical excellence and innovation.

                        The ParkLogic team is dedicated to delivering intelligent solutions that increase revenue for clients. Alongside an advanced suite of tools, they work closely with partners to help them achieve their goals and unlock the full potential of their domain portfolios.

                        Learn more
